These are recorded genuine exports from the marked, controlled classroom world
in `tests/education-fixture.ts`, using `fixture(true)`. Position controls isolate
classroom attendance; these fixtures do not establish natural commuting,
unbounded wealth or a long-run economic result. Roles, teachers, employment,
wages, supplier ownership, material stock and original qualification gates come
from the real constructor and simulation. No education or research minutes are
inserted into these genuine inputs.

Both runs complete three actual sixty-minute courses, each funded with forty
coins and one finite workshop textbook, then pass the original eighty-coin
scientist examination. A temporary course purchases a real textbook without
earning time, is cancelled with only unearned escrow refunded, and leaves that
textbook in school stock. A fourth forty-coin course reserves the returned book
and a real medicine research command spends one hundred coins. The same-start
run then advances four minutes. The different-start run advances one class
minute before the research admission, then advances four more minutes.

The normal test verifies fixture SHA, genuine exact restoration, only the two
coordinated research fields changing, individual elapsed bounds still holding,
combined suffix overuse, rejection without any live-byte mutation, and exact
twenty-four-phase continuation. It also advances the genuine same-start class
to a real sixty-minute terminal history record before testing the retained
history bound. The guard is a necessary capacity constraint over explicit new
records, not a complete historical tamper proof. Archived aggregates and
grandfathered records without explicit labor remain outside that claim.
